summary.text: Jason Petrie is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 16 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A self-employed attorney from Elkton, he chairs the House Appropriations and Revenue Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jason Petrie was born on February 27, 1971, and as of February 2020 lived in Elkton, Kentucky.
He earned a bachelor of arts in economics and philosophy from Berea College, a master's degree in humanities from Western Kentucky University, and a J.D. from The Ohio State University.
His career experience includes working as a self-employed attorney.
Petrie took office in the Kentucky House in 2017.
For 2025-2026 he chaired the House Appropriations and Revenue Committee and was also assigned to the House Judiciary Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
